name_usage u JOIN name n ON n.dataset_key=u.dataset_key AND n.id=u.name_id LEFT JOIN reference ra ON ra.dataset_key=u.dataset_key AND ra.id=u.according_to_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT (bn.id,bn.rank,bn.scientific_name,bn.authorship)::simple_name AS sn FROM name_rel br JOIN name bn ON bn.dataset_key=${releaseKey} AND bn.id=br.related_name_id WHERE br.dataset_key=${releaseKey} AND br.name_id=n.id AND br.type='BASIONYM'::nomreltype ORDER BY bn.id LIMIT 1 ) bas ON true LEFT JOIN taxon_metrics m ON m.dataset_key=u.dataset_key AND m.taxon_id=u.id LEFT JOIN taxon_metrics mp ON mp.dataset_key=u.dataset_key AND mp.taxon_id=u.parent_id LEFT JOIN name_usage up ON up.dataset_key=u.dataset_key AND up.id=u.parent_id LEFT JOIN name np ON np.dataset_key=u.dataset_key AND np.id=up.name_id LEFT JOIN reference rp ON rp.dataset_key=u.dataset_key AND rp.id=n.published_in_id
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM name_usage_archive WHERE dataset_key=#{datasetKey}

SELECT u.id, u.release_keys, u.n_scientific_name AS name, u.n_authorship AS authorship, u.name_phrase AS phrase, u.n_rank AS rank, u.n_code AS code, u.status, CASE WHEN is_synonym(u.status) THEN (u.accepted).name ELSE u.classification[array_upper(u.classification, 1)].name END AS parent, u.classification, m.index_id AS canonical_id, m.index_id AS namesIndexId,
'NONE'::MATCHTYPE AS namesIndexMatchType FROM name_usage_archive u LEFT JOIN name_usage_archive_match m ON m.dataset_key=u.dataset_key AND m.usage_id=u.id WHERE u.dataset_key=#{datasetKey} ORDER BY m.index_id

mapper.update: UPDATE name_usage_archive a SET () = () FROM WHERE a.dataset_key=#{projectKey} AND u.dataset_key=${releaseKey} AND a.id=u.id AND NOT (a.release_keys && ) AND () IS DISTINCT FROM ()

UPDATE name_usage_archive a SET release_keys = (SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT k ORDER BY k) FROM unnest(array_append(a.release_keys, ${releaseKey})) AS k) FROM name_usage u WHERE a.dataset_key=#{projectKey} AND u.dataset_key=${releaseKey} AND a.id=u.id AND NOT (a.release_keys @> ARRAY[${releaseKey}])
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM name_usage u WHERE u.dataset_key=${releaseKey} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT true FROM name_usage_archive a WHERE a.dataset_key=#{projectKey} AND a.id=u.id)
